name: Crew tool
provides: Report progress, deliver files, remember preferences (Chief also recruits and assigns)

name: Files
provides: Read and write files in the bot's own folder

name: Web search and fetch
provides: Search the web and read pages

name: ffmpeg
provides: Render, cut and convert video, audio and images
install: sudo pacman -S ffmpeg  |  sudo apt install ffmpeg  |  brew install ffmpeg

name: ImageMagick
provides: Resize, crop, compose and annotate images
install: sudo pacman -S imagemagick  |  sudo apt install imagemagick  |  brew install imagemagick

name: agent-browser
provides: Drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill, screenshot

name: GitHub CLI
provides: Read issues, pull requests and repos with your own gh sign-in
install: https://cli.github.com (then gh auth login, in your own terminal)

name: Computer (desklink)
provides: The bot's own desktop you can watch and take over from your phone
install: Waiting on @desklink/host as a standalone package
